quote: Temporal knowledge graph question answering (TKGQA) focuses on obtaining answers using the knowledge in TKGs.
To further enhance the temporal reasoning capabilities of LLMs, in this paper, we aim to integrate temporal knowledge into LLMs, thereby addressing complex and multi-granularity temporal questions.
